## What happens

Seen by the browser-pass runner while measuring the permission matrix at a narrow viewport (1440 → 820 px wide, 900 high), stock showcase, admin: on the Setup metadata admin page for permission sets (`/_console/apps/setup/metadata/permission?scope=environment`), the breadcrumb row and the item's type / badge chips collide and overprint — the runner read the row as "All Metadata T…SECURITY Pe create-only P…". The matrix itself stays usable at that width (its own horizontal scroll works); only the header row breaks.

## Where (objectui `1fb1ced36243`)

The metadata admin page header — `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.tsx` and the header/breadcrumb it renders (the fixing seat confirms the exact component). Single observation, not scored against a clause: re-check at 820 px before fixing.

## Expected

At narrow widths the breadcrumb truncates or wraps on its own line, and the chips move below it — nothing overprints.
